question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

Let’s check each option:

1. LKO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eb1ffccdd8bb9a82a0a9d043c9c7f01c46f1f86c058f68459f61ddc2a647bad.png]

2. DCG

This letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

3. VVY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8910dbb448cfcff708620df5a89e83900a5ddb2a7a4f64f1823284a3c5e577e7.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follow the pattern -1, +4.

4. TSW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/985ac2cf47779046291deebf3fd0eacfb97b0a3d09e556448659052f51869c18.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern -1, +4.

Thus, VVY is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
